1_early_detection.requirement: Detect clinically meaningful obstruction before conventional clinical deterioration

2_differential_diagnosis.requirement: Distinguish obstruction, valve degradation, venous backpressure, migration, physiology

3_multi_fault_robustness.requirement: Doesn't collapse when two faults occur simultaneously

5_minimal_hardware.requirement: Software/firmware capability using signals eShunt can provide
5_minimal_hardware.evidence: Requires: 2 pressure sensors (CSF + venous) + controllable valve. All are existing eShunt components or minimal additions.

6_eShunt_specificity.requirement: Venous downstream boundary must be essential to the method
6_eShunt_specificity.evidence: P_venous is a load-bearing variable in the state estimation. VP shunts lack venous boundary → algorithm cannot work.

7_reproducibility.requirement: Same patient/device produces consistent estimates over repeated interrogations
